title: Shortened First Approvals of Non-Formulary Exceptions (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a first-approval shortening is applied to a standard non-formulary exception approval when the member has never held an approval for the drug. Two records are read: the member's exception history for the drug, and the prior-authorization list of the member's review package under the Utilization Management Program.

| An approval of an exception for the drug is on record | Drug on the review package's prior-authorization list | Taken off the period |
|---|---|---|
| no | yes | **6** months |
| no | no | **3** months |
| yes | any | nothing |

The shortening is taken off the approval period before the floor of one month is applied.

*Hypothetical.* A member's first-ever approval for a drug on the package's prior-authorization list loses 6 months. The same member's later approval for that drug, once an earlier approval is on record, loses nothing under this clause. A first approval for a drug not on the list loses 3 months.
